News / Benzinga / ‘Eyes on Hormuz’: Analyst Warns Iran May Defy US Blockade With Oil Exports, Flags Hormuz Vessel Strikes as Trump Is ‘Not Rushing’ Decis…

‘Eyes on Hormuz’: Analyst Warns Iran May Defy US Blockade With Oil Exports, Flags Hormuz Vessel Strikes as Trump Is ‘Not Rushing’ Decisions (CORRECTED) 2 min read

Editor’s Note: An earlier version of this article contained a n error in a quote from Brett Erickson. It has been corrected. Obsidian Risk Advisors ‘ Managing Principal Brett Erickson said Thursday that Iran may try to export oil despite the U.S. naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz amid ongoing tensions between Washington and Tehran . Coming Days Could Be ‘Incredibly Consequential’ In a post on the social media platform X , Erickson quoted Iran’s semi-official Fars News Agency, which said tanker companies reportedly said Iran was preparing to export oil, but that no Iranian official had confirmed the news. Citing Fars, Erickson said there had been no “any official CONFIRMATION of Iran’s attempts to break the U.S. blockade.” However, the risk analyst then cited a post by TankerTrackers on Thursday that claimed the country was preparing to move oil again

TankerTrackers.com, Inc. @TankerTrackers

BREAKING: Iran appears to be preparing to ship out oil again. #OOTT #IranWar #Tankers

Nov 19, 2026

“It seems that the next hours and days could be incredibly consequential… Eyes on Hormuz,” Erickson said in his post.

Brett Erickson @BrettErickson28

According to a recent statement from Fars News, there hasn’t been any official CONFIRMATION of Iran’s attempts to break the U.S. blockade. However, given TankerTrackers very abrupt post highlighting that Iran was preparing to export oil again, it seems that the next hours and… https://t.co/HJs2ZrFeW9

Nov 19, 2026

Erickson, in a separate post, said that Iran was firing at vessels in the Strait of Hormuz again. Notably, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations Center (UKTMO) reported on Thursday that a vessel off the coast of Oman was struck by an “unknown projectile” when transiting the Strait of Hormuz. “What is particularly notable over the last 24 hours is that the United States (for now) has STOPPED striking Iran following Iran’s attacks on Bahrain and Kuwait,” he said. The risk analyst also warned that the situation was not even “remotely sustainable.”

Brett Erickson @BrettErickson28

NOW: Iran is currently firing at vessels in the Strait of Hormuz again. What is particularly notable over the last 24 hours is that the United States (for now) has STOPPED striking Iran following Iran’s attacks on Bahrain and Kuwait. However… none of this is remotely…

Nov 19, 2026

Trump Says No Rush on Iran Decision Amid this, Axios reported on Thursday that Trump said he was not “rushing into any decision” on Iran, adding that the administration will wait until the new year to take any decision on the issue. The report also said that the timeline could point to the administration wanting to see how the naval blockade, as well as the economic restrictions imposed by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent , play out for Iran. Oil, Gas Movement According to the American Automobile Association (AAA) data, the national average price of gas on Thursday was $3.7212/gallon. Diesel also fell below $6 on Thursday, with the national average at $5.9298/gallon. At press time, West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures contracts expiring in January were up 0.46% to $82.82. Brent futures contracts expiring in January also gained 0.49% to $92.43 at the time of writing. According to Benzinga Pro data, the ProShares Ultra Bloomberg Crude Oil (NYSE: UCO) ETF was down 0.63% to $48.60 during overnight trading on Thursday. The United States Oil Fund (NYSE: USO) ETF also slipped 0.31% to $137.66 during overnight trading. Disclaimer Preview Photo: Dylan Hayes Photo / Shutterstock

News / Coindar / Cartesi to Close Vote on CTSI MinterRole Renunciation on November 25th

Cartesi to Close Vote on CTSI MinterRole Renunciation on November 25th Less than 1 min read

CTSIUSD

Cartesi will close voting on November 25th on a proposal to renounce the remaining MinterRole permissions in the CTSI token contract. The voting period runs from November 18th–25th following a 21-day consultation. Refer to the official tweet by CTSI:

Cartesi @cartesiproject

Itâ€™s time to vote! The proposal to renounce the remaining MinterRole permissions on the $CTSI token contract is now open for voting, following a 21-day consultation period. Review the details and cast your vote here: https://t.co/qfaEWpIK5k Voting period 🗓ï¸ Nov 18 - Nov 25 pic.twitter.com/EywpwXewyy

Nov 18, 2026

CTSI Info Cartesi (CTSI) is a blockchain project aiming to make the development and deployment of decentralized applications (DApps) more practical and scalable. It does this by enabling smart contracts to run off-chain computations in a Linux environment, which opens up the possibility to use mainstream programming languages and software, as well as access larger amounts of data more efficiently. The fundamental piece of technology behind Cartesi is the Descartes SDK, a software development kit that provides a set of tools and services to help developers build scalable and secure DApps. With Descartes, computations can be intensive and incorporate complex business logic as they are executed off-chain in a Linux environment. The Cartesi token (CTSI) serves multiple utility purposes within the Cartesi ecosystem. It is used as a staking mechanism in the network's Proof-of-Stake (PoS) consensus algorithm, and also as a means to pay for computational resources within the network. In addition, it's used in the network's incentive system for data availability and computation verification.

News / Coindar / Nym to Host Community Call on November 19th

Nym to Host Community Call on November 19th Less than 1 min read

Nym will hold a community call with David Schwartz of the Litecoin Foundation on November 19th at 14:00 UTC, streamed on YouTube and Twitch. The discussion will cover MWEB confidential transactions, optional versus default privacy, and Litecoin’s approach to financial privacy. Refer to the official tweet by NYM:

Nym @nym

NYM Community Call with David Schwartz from @litecoin November 19 | 14:00 UTC Set Reminderâ¤µï¸ YT: https://t.co/ygjVmbgYDX Twitch: https://t.co/B6tdAZlRjp 🪙 How MWEB brought privacy to Litecoin 🔐 Optional vs default: the design choice 👩â€💻 Litecoin's take on financial privacyâ€¦ pic.twitter.com/XHZQwuZ4QY

Nov 19, 2026

NYM Info Users employ NYM tokens to gain access to the mixnet, consequently improving the privacy of their data. NYM is also used as a reward for mix nodes in exchange for their services in traffic mixing and privacy assurance for Nym network users. Fees accumulated in NYM are directed to a reward pool and later distributed amongst mix nodes, based on their performance and reputation. Each mix node's reputation is quantified in NYM tokens. Moreover, users have the option to delegate their NYM tokens to mix nodes. This action serves as a validation of a mix node's reputation and grants the user a portion of the mix node's rewards. Users are encouraged to delegate their NYM to nodes that consistently deliver quality services as it increases their likelihood of earning rewards. However, it should be noted that NYM is not a general-purpose payment mechanism or a typical cryptocurrency, such as Bitcoin. Its utilization is exclusively intended for activities within the Nym network.
